checklist.pbss_target: exact normalized psi formula before the explicit theta correction
required_matches: negative coefficient sign and full complex phases
uniformity_notes: Choose one cutoff G=exp(T) on log(2)<=y<=T
checklist.adapted_conclusion: F_psi(y)=Re sum_{0<gamma<=G}[-2 m_gamma exp(i gamma y)/(1/2+i gamma)] + O(exp(y/2)*(y+log G)^2/G + y exp(-y/2)).

checklist.pbss_target: O(1/T) moments of the full psi residual
uniformity_notes: The zero-block constant is independent of G; no arbitrary-N M5 inference
checklist.citation_name: Uniform control of the growing zero-block moments
checklist.adapted_conclusion: Integral_0^1 F_psi(Tu)g(u)du=O_g(1/T), uniformly in the retained zero block because sum m_gamma/(gamma*abs(1/2+i gamma)) converges.

checklist.pbss_target: Q_theta=F_psi-1+h with h in L1 intersect L2
uniformity_notes: h(Tu) has O(1/T) moments and O(1/T) squared norm
checklist.citation_name: Explicit prime-square correction and integrable secondary error
classical_refs: Exact identity psi(x)-theta(x)=sum_{j>=2} theta(x^(1/j)); RH error estimate
checklist.adapted_conclusion: Q_theta(y)=F_psi(y)-1+h(y), h in L1 intersect L2. The detrend removes -1; h(Tu) contributes O(1/T) moments and O(1/T) squared norm.

checklist.pbss_target: positive limiting norm of continuous q_T
uniformity_notes: No simplicity or linear independence assumption; V>0
checklist.citation_name: Positive mean-square limit for the exact psi residual
checklist.adapted_conclusion: (1/T) Integral_0^T F_psi(y)^2 dy -> V=2 sum_{gamma>0} m_gamma^2/(1/4+gamma^2), 0<V<infinity. The continuous affine-detrended theta residual has the same norm limit.

uniformity_notes: M6 proves model transfer only; a bounded taper does not prove norm comparability
checklist.citation_name: Optional transfer to a weighted arithmetic residual
classical_refs: M6 covers fixed absolutely continuous weights on model modes
checklist.adapted_conclusion: Not included in the continuous arithmetic theorem. Bounded weights alone do not ensure comparable weighted and unweighted norms.

checklist.pbss_target: probes.arithmetic_residual returns finite samples with sample least-squares detrend
required_matches: quadrature and detrend errors on the claimed scale
uniformity_notes: Fixed samples do not inherit the continuous limit theorem
A finite numerical check does not prove that delta tends to zero

ANT.recommendation: Use the exact continuous theorem and its primary sources. Keep optional weighted and sampled transfers separate; finite model checks do not establish a T-limit.

threshold.banner: NOT AN UNCONDITIONAL PROOF OF RH
threshold.title: B-RES threshold / obstruction package

threshold_hypothesis.statement: For q_arith=q_off+q_rest, a sufficient H* is liminf_T (||P_d q_off||-||P_d q_rest||)/||q_arith|| ≥ ε > 0. A lower bound on ||P_d q_off|| alone is insufficient.
threshold_hypothesis.implies: The reverse triangle inequality gives liminf R_d(q_arith) ≥ ε^2. The strengthened component margin is sufficient, not necessary.
threshold_hypothesis.counterexample_below: An intact continuous off-mode already has R_d=O(1/T). Also q_rest=-P_d q_off+h_perp cancels its projected contribution exactly.
threshold_hypothesis.status_for_zeta: For exact continuous degree-one detrending and fixed d>=2, liminf R_d=0 unconditionally. The assertion off-critical zero => liminf R_d>0 is therefore RH-equivalent and remains open.
threshold_hypothesis.scope: Exact continuous theta residual, du projection; no sampled transfer asserted.

model_cancellation_counterexample.note: Forced V_d removal ⇒ R_d≈0; model of cancellation below B-RES threshold

threshold.conclusion: Finite sampled controls do not prove a projection floor. Exact continuous off-modes vanish; the arithmetic liminf is also zero unconditionally. B-ABS proves an absolute-moment RH equivalence; its unconditional growth bound and the normalized converse remain open.
